usage: A very common Cantonese greeting used in the morning
Often said when meeting someone at the start of the day
More natural and widely used than formal greetings like 早上好
Can be shortened casually to 早

examples.jyutping: zou2 san4, nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6
examples.meaning: Good morning, have you eaten yet?

examples.jyutping: zou2 san4, gam1 jat6 dim2 aa3

examples.sentence: 我每日返工都會同同事講早晨。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 faan1 gung1 dou1 wui5 tung4 tung4si6 gong2 zou2 san4
examples.meaning: Every day when I go to work, I say good morning to my colleagues.
